script.name: Install Wine and its dependencies
script.description: Installs wine, winetricks, Xvfb and xdotool on the host (apt, dnf or yum) and Wine Mono and the Visual C++ runtime into the Wine prefix. Skips what is installed.

script.name: Prepare the server
script.description: Installs missing Visual C++ runtimes, syncs the configuration with the service (IP, ports, slots, password hash, admins) and applies the gameplay settings to the current world.

script.name: Save the world and shut down
script.description: Sends Ctrl+C to the server, which saves the world and shuts down, then ends the process (it waits for a key press).

script.name: Add the Workshop mod to the world
script.description: Adds the mod to the mod list of the world; the server downloads and loads it on its next start.

script.name: Remove the Workshop mod from the world
script.description: Removes the mod from the mod list of the world and deletes its downloaded files.

script.name: Torch: switch to Torch
script.description: Sets Torch up (log file, permissions) and starts the service with Torch.Server.exe. Runs after the Torch update.

script.name: Torch: switch to the plain server
script.description: Starts the service with the plain dedicated server again. Runs after the Vanilla update.

script.name: Torch: keep it installed
script.description: A service that runs Torch gets the latest Torch build again after a reinstall or a Steam update.
